sem_line_profile — GENERATIVE sem op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.sem_line_profile(line_material='PMMA', substrate='SI', energy_kev: 'float' = 1.0, *, width_nm: 'float' = 40.0, height_nm: 'float' = 40.0, sidewall_deg: 'float' = 88.0, beam_sigma_nm: 'float' = 1.0, x_half_range_nm=None, x_step_nm: 'float' = 1.0, electrons_per_point: 'int' = 200, buried=None, seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import sem; sem.sem_line_profile(line_material='PMMA', substrate='SI', energy_kev: 'float' = 1.0, *, width_nm: 'float' = 40.0, height_nm: 'float' = 40.0, sidewall_deg: 'float' = 88.0, beam_sigma_nm: 'float' = 1.0, x_half_range_nm=None, x_step_nm: 'float' = 1.0, electrons_per_point: 'int' = 200, buried=None, seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsgenerative.get("sem_line_profile"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Monte Carlo line profile of a beam scanned across one line with a trapezoidal cross-section (CD-SEM).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

線は y に一様。底辺の幅 width_nm・高さ height_nm・側壁角 sidewall_deg (90 = 垂直)の台形で、材料 line_material が基板 substrate の上に乗る(height_nm = 0 なら平らな基板)。ビームは幅 beam_sigma_nm のガウシアン、位置ごとに electrons_per_point 個を撃つ。buried は基板に埋もれた矩形の列 [(材料名, x0, x1, 上端の深さ, 下端の深さ), ...] [nm]。

Returns

dict

x_nm / 検出器ごとの信号 se_total・inlens・everhart・bse

(電子 1 個あたり)/ eta / profile(pairs: x と inlens)/

真の寸法 width_bottom_nm・width_top_nm・width_mid_nm。

Examples

>>> r = sem_line_profile(energy_kev=1.0, width_nm=30, height_nm=20, x_half_range_nm=30,

... x_step_nm=10, electrons_per_point=40)

>>> r["profile"].shape

(7, 2)
